headline: JSA, Khaitan & Co act on Temasek's ₹2,500 crore investment in Godrej Capital
sum: Temasek Holdings is set to invest ₹2,500 crore in Godrej Capital Limited, the financial services arm of Godrej Industries Limited. JSA Advocates and Solicitors advised Temasek Holdings on this transaction.
detail: Temasek Holdings is set to invest ₹2,500 crore in Godrej Capital Limited, the financial services arm of Godrej Industries Limited. JSA Advocates and Solicitors advised Temasek Holdings on this transaction. The JSA team was led by Vikram Raghani (Senior Partner), and assisted by Bir Bahadur Sachar (Partner), Farah Titina (Principal Associate), Vaishnavi Vyas (Senior Associate), Associates Yagnesh Sharma, Krishna Giri Nair, Samika Pachouly, Ankitaa Nair, Rashika Sharda, Sharanya Rangaraj, Aditi Yadav, and Niki Shah (Senior Company Secretary). Competition aspects: Vaibhav Choukse (Partner), Ela Bali (Partner), Aditi Khanna (Principal Associate), and Aarathi R Menon (Associate).
